direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px/52px/1fr/56px, cols 184px/1fr/360px; FactoryStage >=55vw x >=60vh at 1366x768, Inspector internal-scroll only, DecisionBar pinned

colorTokens.stoppedRed: #E5484D only for stopped/offline CELL-MILL-2 outline, OFFLINE/STOPPED text and cross-hatch; owner-required exception
colorTokens.logo: Immutable black/emerald/neon-green/brushed-silver asset at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story; never recolor, crop, redraw or add elsewhere

direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection/panel; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and keeps pattern+marker+text

components.Header: 48px; official logo left, live state centre-right, Lock recovery room as button
components.StepRail: 9 steps from single steps array; 36-40px icon+text+colour buttons, completed/current/locked, aria-current=step; remove dead Workspaces disclosure
components.GuideStrip: 52px; Step X of 9, instruction + status only, no duplicate primary action
components.FactoryStage: Focusable cinematic SVG synced to inspector selection; every node keyboard-reachable; 2px #A8F04A focus outline offset 2px
components.EvidenceInspector: 360px; current task only, required action pinned, internal scroll only; blocked prior tasks as collapsed group until replacements are approved
components.DecisionBar: 56px; Back left, human decision/status centre, one primary right; invalidating actions separated and text-labelled
components.Keyboard: Skip-to-stage first; header > rail > guide > SVG nodes > inspector > DecisionBar; arrows in rail/SVG, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite for results only

visualizations.FactorySVG: Inline 960x540 cinematic side-elevation: dock/held lot, QA gate, conveyor, brushed-silver CELL-MILL-1/2, JOB-1001/1002 bays; silver idle, neon only feasible/accepted, red only stopped CELL-MILL-2, never route through offline cell
visualizations.StateBinding: Bind nodes, routes, badges, counts and inspector to real state: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible paths, online/offline, acceptance, events, sealed packet; pending proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks coexist with approved revised plan; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form
visualizations.Evidence: Aligned Certificate 120 vs Receiving 80 quantity tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-inspector highlight

Replace the schematic boxes with the cinematic SVG dock, QA gate, conveyor and silver cells, keeping RECEIVING held and the 120 vs 80 mismatch dominant.

Label the select as evidence investigation only; keep nonce/identity pre-flight checks in a separate Route control group, never merged with this task.
Show route options as radio cards with cost/availability markers rather than a dense native select at 360px.
Move No model has run yet into one 13px status line so the stage title and mismatch stay the visual focus at 768px.
Add visible focus and exact-match progress to the typed phrase field; keep Accept disabled with an aria-describedby reason until the phrase matches.
Compress comparison cards to 64px each so the pinned consent form never needs page scroll and remains visible with the list scrolling internally.
Add Selected-path text+check, not colour alone, on Use verified substitute in both comparison and stage option chips.
Keep all three proposed tasks explicitly PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL and show 0 tracked beside them until Approve is pressed.
Add owner/dependency/due as tabular rows with text markers so t2 after t1 and t3 after t2 scan without reading paragraphs.
Separate Decline proposal from Approve Britt's proposal by spacing and label it as returning the proposal, not deleting tracked work.
Pre-visualise the consequence: selecting CELL-MILL-2 shows its SVG outline previewing red cross-hatch OFFLINE before Apply second shock is pressed.
Keep Start a fresh scenario (admin) visually and spatially separate from the invalidating action with a divider and destructive text label.
State in the DecisionBar centre exactly which acceptance is invalidated, matching the inspector warning verbatim.
Retain red only on CELL-MILL-2 outline, OFFLINE label and cross-hatch; remove any red from routes, badges or the mismatch headline beyond existing evidence tracks.
Add a 3-to-2 feasible-path delta chip bound to state next to the dashed change banner, with pattern+text.
Keep investigation distinct from pre-flight: show the chosen route name on the Reinvestigate recovery button, not a generic health check.

Render the constrained Split option disabled with X marker, text reason and no selectable radio; feasible options remain keyboard-selectable and open this consent form.
Shorten Scenario changed - review required and plan/expiry lines to two lines maximum to restore hierarchy at 768px.

Add a BLOCKED pattern+text chip inside the collapsed prior-work group header so its state reads without opening it.
Never route the accepted flow through red offline CELL-MILL-2; keep the neon route on CELL-MILL-1 only.

Separate the three actions in the inspector: Verify ledger, passphrase entry, and Export independent checkpoint each with its own labelled fieldset; the DecisionBar primary must mirror only the next required one.
Fix the Before-After panel cut-off text; allow internal scroll with a visible fade and keep 70 / 35h / 48h always visible.
Add text+icon verified/unverified state to the ledger button result via aria-live, not colour alone.
Replace Review recovery proof in the DecisionBar with a clearly terminal state or a single reopen-proof action, since the packet is already sealed.
Mask the passphrase field consistently and add a show/hide toggle with keyboard focus, keeping the meets-minimum status as text.
Mark step 10 in the rail as completion outside the 9 guided steps, with a check marker and distinct complete styling.
